topics.title: Mini-Quiz 1
topics.summary: Mini-Quiz 1 What does IAM stand for? A) Internal Audit Management B) Identity and Access Management C) Information Architecture Model D) Internet Account Manager Answer: B) Identity and Access Management.

topics.title: Mini-Quiz 2
topics.summary: Mini-Quiz 2 Which of the following is an example of Authentication? A) Checking user permissions for a resource B) Entering a password to verify identity C) Reviewing user activity logs D) Assigning a user to an admin group Answer: B) Entering a password to verify identity.

topics.title: Mini-Quiz 3
topics.summary: Mini-Quiz 3 Which risk is associated with poor offboarding processes? A) Faster user access to new resources B) Reduced licensing costs C) Former employees retaining access to sensitive systems D) Improved password strength Answer: C) Former employees retaining access to sensitive systems.

topics.title: Mini-Quiz 4
topics.summary: Mini-Quiz 4 Which is NOT a benefit of implementing IAM? A) Improved security B) Reduced compliance efforts C) Increased user productivity D) Greater insider threat risks Answer: D) Greater insider threat risks.
